prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1172; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with reported head impact and subsequent concussive symptoms including headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism and force of the collision are consistent with the injury described. Over the course of twelve visits, care proceeded along a typical clinical pathway, combining symptom monitoring, vestibular and cognitive assessment, graded activity guidance, and education on symptom management. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly support the diagnosis of concussion. There is no known prior injury or treatment involving the same region. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms resolved, and the patient was discharged to full activity with instructions to return if new or worsening symptoms develop. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered without duplication.
